activation.oneTimeWarning: The complete activation code is shown only this time. Copy it or export the QR code now.
activation.recoveryHint: First verify the store, account and creation reason in the grant records or Web admin. Confirm the original request has ended. If a grant exists but its credential was lost, revoke that grant first. Only clear the block after confirming no grant is left unresolved. This action does not create anything; a new creation requires another explicit submission.
activation.recoveredHint: The block is cleared. No grant was created; submit again only if another creation is needed.
activation.pendingHint: The original request is still running. Wait and refresh the records before clearing the block.
activation.unknownOutcomeHint: The creation result is unconfirmed, so another attempt is blocked. Check the grants first. If a grant exists but its complete credential was not received, revoke that grant. Closing this sheet does not remove the block.
activation.accountHint: A Mobile activation code binds to the selected target account at this store.
activation.reasonHint: A reason of 1–200 characters is required.
activation.noAccessDescription: Ask an administrator for POS or Mobile activation-code management permission.

emergency.createHint: Emergency access applies only to the current store. Both creation and revocation are audited.
emergency.existingHint: This store already has a grant. The complete credential is shown only when it is created.
